2.1.1. Certification_LCF_Dump.api.generate_certification_lcf¶

Certification_LCF_Dump.api.generate_certification_lcf(config)¶

Top-level function that generates LCF files to be provided to Prover Certifier, namely:

  • Types.lcf

  • Railyard.lcf

  • LCF2Inst.lmc

  • LCF2Intg.lmc

  • LCF2IntgProj.lmc

  • LCF2Tab.lmc

  • LCF2Par.lmc

  • Primary LCF tables

Parameters:

config (Config) – Configuration object.
